# Question of Interest

How have gas prices changed over time?

**Goal:** Make a simple line plot.

## 1. Packages & Dependencies

```{r packages, message = FALSE}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(here)
library(showtext)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# Load helper functions
source(here::here("R/utils/tidy_tuesday_helpers.R"))

# Set project title
title <- "xkcd Color Survey"
tt_date <- "2025-07-08"

```

## 2. Load Data

```{r data_load, message = FALSE}
# Load data from tidytuesdayR package
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(tt_date)

# Extract elements from tuesdata
answers <- tuesdata$answers
color_ranks <- tuesdata$color_ranks
users <- tuesdata$users

# Remove tuesdata file
rm(tuesdata)

#color = "#4B31EA" color = "#0343df"
#color = "#584601" color = "#653700"
#color = "#DA239C" color = "#ff81c0"

```

## 3. Examine Data

```{r data_headers}
# View data
head(answers)
head(color_ranks)
head(users)

```

## 4. Cleaning

```{r cleaning}
# Join dataframes
df <- answers |> 
  left_join(color_ranks, by = "rank") |> 
  left_join(users, by = "user_id") |> 
  rename(
    color_shown_hex = hex.x, 
    color_guessed_name = color,
    color_guessed_hex = hex.y
  ) |> 
  filter(
    spam_prob <= 0.5,
    !is.na(color_shown_hex), 
    !is.na(color_guessed_hex)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    monitor = if_else(monitor == "monitor-other", "Other", monitor),
    y_chromosome = recode(y_chromosome, "0" = "Female", "1" = "Male"),
    colorblind   = recode(colorblind,   "0" = "No",     "1" = "Yes")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    y_chromosome = replace_na(y_chromosome, "NA"),
    colorblind   = replace_na(colorblind,   "NA")
  )

```

```{r}
# Define functions
# Convert hex to RGB
hex_to_rgb <- function(hex) {
  rgb <- col2rgb(hex)
  return(as.numeric(rgb))
}

# Compute Euclidean distance
color_distance_rgb <- function(rgb1, rgb2) {
  sqrt(sum((rgb1 - rgb2)^2))
}

```

```{r}
df <- df |> 
  mutate(
    color_shown_rgb = map(color_shown_hex, hex_to_rgb),
    color_guessed_rgb = map(color_guessed_hex, hex_to_rgb),
    dist = map2_dbl(color_shown_rgb, color_guessed_rgb, color_distance_rgb),
    across(c(monitor, y_chromosome, colorblind), as.factor)
  )

```

```{r}
monitor <- df |> 
  group_by(monitor) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_dist = mean(dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_guesses = n()) |> 
  mutate(monitor = fct_reorder(monitor, avg_dist, .desc = TRUE))

monitor

y_chromosome <- df |> 
  group_by(y_chromosome) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_dist = mean(dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_guesses = n()) |> 
  mutate(y_chromosome = fct_reorder(y_chromosome, avg_dist, .desc = TRUE))

y_chromosome

colorblindness <- df |> 
  group_by(colorblind) |> 
  summarize(
    avg_dist = mean(dist, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_guesses = n()) |> 
mutate(colorblind = fct_reorder(colorblind, avg_dist, .desc = TRUE))


colorblindness

```

## 5. Visualization Parameters

```{r visualization_parameters}
# Load fonts
font_add(
  family = "Lato",
  regular = "/Library/Fonts/Lato-Regular.ttf",
  bold = "/Library/Fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf"
)
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

```

## 6. Visualization

```{r echo=FALSE}

# P1: Monitor
p1 <- ggplot(monitor, aes(x = monitor, y = avg_dist)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E5166") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_dist)), color = "#4E5166", vjust = -0.75) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(0, 110)) +
  labs(x = "Monitor Type", y = "Average Euclidean Distance") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = -5)),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

# P2: Gender
p2 <- ggplot(y_chromosome, aes(x = y_chromosome, y = avg_dist)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#9A8C98") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_dist)), color = "#4E5166", vjust = -0.75) +
  labs(x = "Gender") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(0, 110)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 107, label = "Shorter bar = less error", color = "#4B6F44", hjust = 0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("curve", 
           x = 2.6, xend = 3, 
           y = 107, yend = 98, 
           curvature = -0.4, 
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches")),
           color = "#4B6F44") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = -5)),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

# P3: Colorblindness
p3 <- ggplot(colorblindness, aes(x = colorblind, y = avg_dist)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#C9ADA7") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_dist)), color = "#4E5166", vjust = -0.75) +
  labs(x = "Colorblindness") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(0, 110)) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Lato") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = -5)),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

# Final plot
final_plot <- (p1 + p2 + p3) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Which users were most accurate in naming colors?",
    subtitle = "Your instincts are correct: women are better at identifying colors.",
    caption = "\nSOURCE: XKCD Color Survey\nChart produced by Steven Villalon for Tidy Tuesday exercise on July 8, 2025.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F5F2", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "#4E5166", face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, color = "#4E5166"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
    )
  )

```

## 7. Export File

```{r file_export}
# Select file formats to export to
formats_to_export <- c("png", "svg")

# Save files to the output folder (uses custom R script)
save_tt_plots(
  plot = final_plot, 
  title = title, 
  date = tt_date,
  output_folder = "output", 
  formats = formats_to_export, 
  height = 5,
  width = 7,
  dpi = 300
  )

```
